chapter: Musicians of the era: players, drummers, bassists, pianists
title: Claude Jones at Wilberforce and the start of the septet
summary: Claude Jones started on trombone at Wilberforce and joined the Synco Cinco Septet that became the Cotton Pickers.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Well, there's no question, you worked with and knew essentially all of the great trombone players.
Your brother-in-law, what did -- what do we have on Claude Jones, your brother-in-law. He influenced you to take up trombone. Claude Jones.
Well, Claude Jones, you know, he was
going to Wilberforce University and he was a drummer in the Wilberforce orchestra.

And McKinney had this band and for some reason or other in that orchestra they had a trombone. And McKinney didn't have no trombones, so Lawrence -- I mean, Claude -- gee whiz -- Claude Jones started fooling with the trombone while he was in school down there. And he got to playing with the Synco Cinco Septet which later became the McKinney Cottonpickers.
